articles.title: India Malaysia Joint Military Exercise Focuses On Modern Drone Warfare
articles.description: The seventh HARIMAU SHAKTI 2026 exercise in Malaysia emphasizes drone warfare and unmanned systems. Indian and Malaysian troops are collaborating on advanced tactical planning and emerging military technologies through practical demonstrations.

articles.title: India-Malaysia joint military exercise Harimau Shakti 2026 focuses on drone warfare
articles.description: As part of the exercise, personnel from the Indian Army and Malaysian Army participated in professional discussions and practical demonstrations on Manned-Unmanned Teaming (MUM-T), UAS, intelligence integration, geospatial applications and other emerging military technologies.

articles.title: India-Sri Lanka conduct joint military exercise Mitra Shakti 2026 in Maduru Oya
articles.description: India and Sri Lanka are conducting the 12th edition of their joint military exercise, MITRA SHAKTI 2026, at the Army Training School in Maduru Oya, with troops from both countries undertaking specialised training to strengthen their capabilities in counter-terrorism operations.
